name: Carolina Buckthorn

facts.how: Ripe black fruit only, in moderation

caution: Eat only fully ripe BLACK fruit and only in small amounts; unripe red berries are purgative. Because buckthorns can disagree with people, this is a taste-and-wait plant. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Glossy strongly-veined leaves and berries that ripen through red to black on the same cluster. Only the black ones are for eating, sparingly.

sections.title: On the trail
sections.body: A modest sweet snack for the cautious; better known to the birds than to foragers.
